paragraphs: R' Shemaya Hasida. Mentioned in the Zohar, Balak, 186a and 188b.[^1][^2]

notes.text: קפו. קפח:. is rendered 186a and 188b under the period/colon convention. The first stop could also separate locators; no Zohar edition is named or independently checked.
Hasida transliterates חסידא without an identity claim. The abbreviated title remains R'; Hyman supplies only the name and citation.
